title: Understanding Sampling Frame
text: Think about who is actually being considered for selection in this sampling method. It's not about who they want to study, but who they are actually able to ask.

hintAnswer: All Data $$100$$ students that attend discussion section this week.
title: Identifying the Group
text: Which group of students is directly accessible to the TAs for this sampling method?
choices: All Data $$100$$ students that attend discussion section this week.
All UC Berkeley students that spend an $$above-average$$ amount on chocolate milk.
Every fifth student in the discussion section.

title: Clarifying the Sampling Frame
text: The sampling frame is the list or group from which the sample is actually drawn. Consider the context of the discussion sections and who is present there.
